_doc: Trust policy for Beacon's approval gate. First-match-wins; default_action applies when no rule matches. Edit this file to add carve-outs as Larry builds confidence in specific dispatch shapes. Reloaded on every evaluate() call so changes take effect without restart. See scripts/trust_policy.py for the evaluator and schema.

_rule_fields.source: agent/system that initiated the task. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.target: agent receiving the dispatch. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.task_type: label on the task envelope. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.repos: glob list against task.target_repo. [] matches any.
_rule_fields.file_patterns: glob list against task.changed_files. [] matches any.

_example_rules_disabled._note: Pulse-flagged doc-only changes in agent-core auto-approve. Uncomment to enable.

rules._note: AUTONOMY (2026-06-22, Larry-approved). Pulse-auto-dispatch envelopes auto-fire without Larry's pre-build click. The envelope only asks Beacon to DRAFT A SPEC (target_agent=beacon, no build), always targeting ourliberty-agent-core (pulse_check_i._build_dispatch_envelope). Pulse auto-dispatches candidates that are effort in {small, medium} AND state a clear impact (pulse_check_i._is_auto_dispatch_eligible; WIDENED 2026-06-22 from the v1 effort=small + $-quantified filter — large-effort + impact-less proposals still park to the funnel). NOTE: effort is no longer an autonomy brake here — for the downstream Beacon->Forge->agent-core build the guards are the sensitive-path carve-out below (only on declared changed_files), classify_careful's keyword exclusion, Mirror REVIEW_PASS before any merge, and EMERGENCY_HALT/pause. This removes ONLY the 'draft a spec?' click. REVERT = set action back to force_ask (re-read on every evaluate(), no restart). Was force_ask (closed-loop v1, 2026-05-24).

Sensitive-path carve-out (2026-06-21). A Beacon→Forge agent-core dispatch that DECLARES it touches config/systemd/deploy/CI/migrations/account-tier/kill-switch/secrets still asks Larry. CAVEAT (trust_policy._matches_file_patterns): file_patterns only match when the task carries changed_files — true for revisions/re-dispatches and any envelope that enumerates files, but NOT a fresh build request (the files don't exist yet). For fresh dispatches the real guards are (a) the board-drain's classify_careful gate (keeps deploy/migrate/credential cards out of the autonomous supply) and (b) Mirror's review + ESCALATE/halt before any merge. This rule is the secondary net + intent marker. MUST stay ordered BEFORE the broad auto_approve rule (first-match-wins).

AUTONOMY (2026-06-21, Larry-approved 'low-risk code, agent-core'). Beacon→Forge dispatches targeting ourliberty-agent-core auto-fire without Larry's pre-build click. Downstream gates REMAIN fully in force — Mirror REVIEW_PASS before any auto-merge, file-overlap merge serializer, GitHub-truth merge confirmation, EMERGENCY_HALT, /pause. This removes ONLY the pre-dispatch human click; it never auto-merges unreviewed code. Sensitive paths are carved to force_ask by the preceding rule (see its CAVEAT). REVERT = delete this rule (re-read on every evaluate(), no restart). Other repos + pulse-auto-dispatch still force_ask.
